items.body_excerpt:
Noteworthy, again, that every Pacer but Jarace Walker has seen the court tonight. 11 players already, including two-way F Jalen Slawson.

We've seen Carlisle visibly frustrated in recent games. And a guy like Slawson plays hard and makes the right play.

How will JW respond?

quote.author: Tony East
quote.text:
Pacers survive and become the first team to beat the Grizzlies in regulation this season. They were great in crunch time. Health went a long way. Siakam and Nembhard with 20+ each.

Pacers are 3-6, all three wins on the road.

items.title: Onyeka Okongwu gets a runner to go with 10 seconds left and the Hawks survive, 108-104. 45 minutes for Jarace Walker, 41 for Jalen Slawson, 40 for Jay Huff, 42 for second-round rookie Braden Smith in his first NBA start. Six-man rotation nearly got it done.

quote.author: Dan Devine
quote.text: The Pacers have six healthy players, including none of their starters, and they've cut a 15-point Hawks lead to two with 58.7 seconds to go. Hell of an effort by Indiana.

Five players out for the Pacers tonight, all on standard contracts. So their nine standard contracts available tonight: Tyrese Haliburton, Kelly Oubre, Aaron Nesmith, Pascal Siakam, Jay Huff, Quenton Jackson, Larry Nance, Jarace Walker, Obi Toppin.

items.title: Still work to do for Kelly Oubre, but better today on offense thanks to some cutting/slashing. Four makes, mostly right at the cup. On the bad side, three fouls already and out he goes for Jarace Walker, who has behind Oubre and Jalen Slawson in the rotation before the fouls.
